2609.24927.title: Et Tu, Brute? Economic Misalignment in Personal AI Agents
2609.24927.paper_summary: Personal AI agents make recommendations and take actions on people's behalf in high-stakes economic contexts, e.g., buying a flight, choosing health insurance, or selecting a graduate program. The agent is given access to the user's personal context, e.g., their email inbox and a structured profile of personal attributes, with the intention of making an optimal, personalized decision for the user. We show that by simply providing this personal context, the agent steers recommendations based on inferred wealth, without being explicitly instructed to do so. In a suite of 325K experiments on 13 agents across three types of economic decisions (flights, health insurance, and graduate programs), we find that 8 models systematically choose more expensive options for wealthier users when requests are identical. This steering continues even when it directly goes against the user's stated objective: when explicitly instructed to find the cheapest option, some agents still act on the wealth profile they have inferred. It also occurs when wealth is inferred from ambient data, such as emails unrelated to the task. And it persists under privacy controls that block specific attributes: blocking financial attributes largely removes the disparity, but blocking other attributes leaves it unchanged and can increase it by up to 40% for insurance, as agents rely on the remaining signals to infer wealth. Larger and more capable models are no better; Claude Opus 4.8 shows the largest effect. We term this misalignment "adversarial delegation", in which the very conditions that make a personal AI agent useful - access to personal information - enable it to act against the user's interests.
2609.24927.paper_summary_zh: 個人 AI 代理在高風險的經濟情境中代表人們做出建議和行動，例如購買航班、選擇健康保險或選擇研究生課程。該代理獲得用戶的個人背景資訊，例如他們的電子郵件收件箱和結構化的個人屬性檔案，旨在為用戶做出最佳的個性化決策。我們顯示，僅僅提供這些個人背景資訊，代理就能根據推斷出的財富來引導建議，而不需要明確指示這樣做。在對 13 個代理進行的 325K 實驗中，涵蓋三種類型的經濟決策（航班、健康保險和研究生課程），我們發現 8 個模型在請求相同的情況下，系統性地為較富裕的用戶選擇更昂貴的選項。這種引導即使在直接違反用戶明確目標的情況下仍然持續存在：當明確指示尋找最便宜的選項時，一些代理仍然根據他們推斷出的財富檔案行動。當財富是從與任務無關的環境數據（例如電子郵件）推斷時，這種情況也會發生。而且在阻止特定屬性的隱私控制下也會持續存在：阻止財務屬性在很大程度上消除了差異，但阻止其他屬性則保持不變，並且對於保險，可能會增加高達 40% 的差異，因為代理依賴剩餘的信號來推斷財富。更大且更強大的模型並沒有更好；Claude Opus 4.8 顯示出最大的影響。我們將這種不對齊稱為「對抗性委託」，在這種情況下，使個人 AI 代理有用的條件——訪問個人信息——使其能夠反對用戶的利益行動。
